value.title: La ragazza prosperosa
value.synopsis: Kimio and Nozomi meets the shy Yuuki Makino, who complexes about her own body. Together they team up to help Makino break out of shell.

value.title: The Clubhouse Ghost
value.synopsis: A ghost is haunting the girls’ swim team, and it’s up to Nozomi and Kimio to investigate! Kimio, however, wants nothing to do with this.

value.title: Our Heartbeats
value.synopsis: Sonoda is not happy when Nozomi beats her in a popularity contest.
